answer:
Pack Check is meant to flag missing dimensions in widget packs. The March roadmap calls for detection, and `src/check.py` contains only a TODO to report the affected line.

I set up a repository-local tracker in [docs/TRACKING.md](docs/TRACKING.md) and verified the link from [README.md](README.md). It records two open items with completion criteria.

- **PC-1** Define the expected pack format and detect missing dimensions.
- **PC-2** Report the line for the affected widget entry once detection exists.

GitLab issue status remains unverified because the fixture provides no hosted snapshot.

# Pack Check tracking

Pack Check is intended to flag missing dimensions in widget packs. The March 2026 roadmap names detection as the next goal, and the source TODO calls for reporting the line where a dimension is missing. The checker source currently contains only that TODO. [README](../README.md) · [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) · [Checker source](../src/check.py)

## Open work

| ID | Work | Status | Done when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PC-1 | Detect missing dimensions in widget packs | Open | The expected pack format and required dimensions are documented, and examples show that the checker flags a pack with a missing dimension and accepts a complete pack. |
| PC-2 | Report the source line for a missing dimension | Open, depends on PC-1 | A missing-dimension report identifies the line for the affected widget entry, verified with a pack containing multiple entries. |

Update the status here as work progresses. When closing an item, add a link to the commit, merge request, or other verification evidence.
